description:
Find geographies by name and get their IDs: 'Austin, TX', 'Cook County', '78701', 'Toronto Centre',
    'Newark ward 5', or a congressional district as 'TX-21' or "Texas's 21st congressional district".

    Results are the best name matches, most populous first, as id, level, name, full_name, region and population;
    call get_geography(id) for the full record. `more` is true when there are further matches: add the state
    ('Springfield, MO') or a filter. country: 'US' or 'CA'. level: one of the levels from coverage_summary (e.g.
    'place', 'county', 'zcta', 'congressional_district', 'federal_electoral_district'). region: USPS state or
    province code ('NJ', 'ON'). This searches names, not street addresses: for an address call lookup_address.
name: search_geographies
title: Search geographies
